newsitem.title: USA: Lawson Products Q4 net, sales both climb.
newsitem.headline: Lawson Products Q4 net, sales both climb.

text.p: Lawson Products Inc said Tuesday a positive adjustment to account for the difference in actual and estimated gross profit rates, along with higher sales, helped boost earnings in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
Lawson reported net income of $6.4 million, or $0.56 a share, compared to $5.7 million, or $0.49 a share, a year ago.
The adjustment added about $528,000 to net income in 1996, while lowering profits by $354,000 in 1995, Lawson said.
Sales rose to $64.4 million from $56.4 million in 1995.
Lawson distributes maintenance, repair and replacement parts and supplies.
Its shares were trading down 3/8 Tuesday at 21-1/4.
